note: Large private resort at Buffalo Bay on the north-west end of Lesser Slave Lake, about 40 km north-east of High Prairie on Hwy 750. Nightly RV sites are spread among several hundred seasonal lots, which go by an application lottery. Two marinas, a restaurant, pontoon-boat, canoe and paddleboard rentals, a fish-cleaning station and long sand beaches. Opens the May long weekend. --Claude
